name: DaysOfWar
description: This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install Days of War and run it. Servername: 'Docker Days-of-War' Password: 'Docker' rconPassword: 'adminDocker' ATTENTION: First Startup can take very long since it downloads the gameserver files! Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available. You can also run multiple servers with only one SteamCMD directory!

ports.name: UDP1 - Game Port
ports.description: UDP Game Port (if you need another port, please delete this entry and create a new UDP Port with the required port number, also don't forget to click on 'Show more settings' in the template and change the portnumber)

ports.name: UDP2 - Steam Port
ports.description: UDP Steam Port (if you need another port, please delete this entry and create a new UDP Port with the required port number, also don't forget to click on 'Show more settings' in the template and change the portnumber)

variables.name: GAME_ID
variables.description: The GAME_ID that the container download at startup. (https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List)

variables.name: GAME_PARAMS
variables.description: Enter your start up commands for the server.

variables.name: Steam-Username
variables.description: Your Steam username goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

variables.name: Validate Installation
variables.description: Set the Variable to 'true' if you want to validate the installation otherwise leave it blank.

variables.name: Steam-Password
variables.description: Your Steam password goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).
